_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A delayed new-conversation recording draft moves after navigation and clears its source. The test seeded a conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). To "start a new conversation from the header": if the button in ".header" whose accessible name is exactly "New Conversation" is visible, click it; otherwise click the button "More options" and then the button "New Conversation" in ".chat-overflow-popover". Click with click steps, not evals. The server's answer to the browser's draft creation (POST /api/conversations/draft) is held back until call "releaseDraft"; call "draftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created the draft and, once it has, sets {{DRAFT}} to its conversation ID; call "draftAnswered" says whether the browser has received the answer. Call "draftText" returns the "draft" field of the last draft creation's request. Recording uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) answer with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/delayed-new.webm. Message submissions are accepted without being sent on; call "chats" counts them, and call "submissions" lists them as JSON, each with its URL path, message and model. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Fill the message input with "Initial text while the draft request starts.".
2. Call "draftCreated" until it returns "true". Call "draftText" must return "Initial text while the draft request starts.".
3. Fill the message input with "Latest text owned by the delayed recording draft.". Click the voice button.
4. Exactly one [data-testid="recording-inline"] should exist, and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should become 1.
5. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The URL should end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}".
6. Call "releaseDraft", then call "draftAnswered" until it returns "true".
7. The recording panel should be visible, the recorder should float, and the URL should still end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}".
8. Click the stop button. Call "chats" should return "1". No recording panel should remain (count 0).
9. Call "submissions" must return exactly [{"path":"/api/conversation/{{DRAFT}}/chat","message":"/transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/delayed-new.webm\nLatest text owned by the delayed recording draft.","model":"predictable"}].
10. The URL should still end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}".
11. Start a new conversation from the header. The URL should end with "/new", and the message input should have the value "" (empty).
